race.title: Juddmonte EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
race.verdict: GALIMIX was a long way clear of the rest when second at Bath 4 weeks ago and the 3 lb he receives from penalised debut winner Tough Decision tips the scales his way. Bizzo Flavin also needs considering after a promising opening effort. GALIMIX (IRE) TOUGH DECISION BIZZO FLAVIN
